steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.howToRead: Reading a melody you haven’t heard: first hear the key note. Then look over the whole tune: where it goes up or down, and where it steps or skips. Sing the first note in your head, then go, keeping a steady beat. If a note goes wrong, keep going: the next one is a fresh start.
steps.auClair: The first phrase of “Au clair de la lune”, as in the song’s transcription. Read it and sing it; the music waits at each note.
steps.auClairAlong: The same phrase, now in time with the metronome.
steps.mary: “Mary Had a Little Lamb”, as in the song’s transcription (an octave up, before it’s moved to your voice). Read it in time.
